decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2672-AR-DR-3003-A1, 2672-AR-DR-3002-A1, 2672-AR-DR-3001-A1, 2672-AR-DR-1050-A1, 2672-AR-DR-1049-A1, 2672-AR-DR-1002-A3, 2672-AR-DR-1001-A1 Received 13/02/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The noise generated from the air condenser unit should be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receptor
description: Installation of new roof level plant including external ductwork and louvers, and installation of new external ductwork stacks and roof level fans
